content.text: I’ll implement only the `apps/codex-proxy` live composition and tests. I’ll first read the current app, its config and existing package exports so the new layer selection stays app-owned and preserves the default mock path.

The current app has the intended contracts but still short-circuits all live requests with a 503. I’m replacing that switch with a config-decoded layer choice: mock stays deterministic, while live composes the encrypted profile store and direct provider chain; configuration failures will become a safe re-import 502 rather than a fallback.

I’ve verified the package already exposes every required production layer, including encrypted storage, Upstash, locks, the unsupported OAuth client, and direct Responses fetch. I’m adding one app-owned composition module plus focused live-mode tests that substitute only package test layers and a mocked fetch, so no credentials or network calls are involved.
